newsitem.title: USA: Mariner sees Q3, subsequent EPS down 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mariner sees Q3, subsequent EPS down 20 pct.

text.p: Mariner Health Group Inc said Thursday it will take a one-time charge of $10 million in the third quarter to increase reserves covering changes in Medicare reimbursements.
The company said it also foresees a 20 percent decrease from analysts' per share earnings estimates for the third quarter and subsequent quarters.
First Call estimates for Mariner were not immediately available.
The company said it is "vigorously contesting" changes that reduce reimbursable Medicare costs and said it is adopting accounting policies to increase reserves covering these expenses.
